import java.util.*;
public class Solution
{
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc=new Scanner(System.in);
        String s = sc.nextLine();
        int c=0;
        int i=0;
        while(i<s.length())
        {
            int j=i;
            while(j<s.length() && s.charAt(j)==s.charAt(i))
            {
                j++;
            }
            int z=j-i;
            if(z%2==0)
                c+=z/2;
            i=j;
        }
        System.out.println(c);
        sc.close();
    }
}
